name: Up Down Plank
instructions: Press up onto one hand then the other.
Lower back to your forearms one at a time.
longevityNotes: A strong, stable core protects the spine in every other movement and makes daily tasks — bending, twisting, reaching — safer. Core endurance matters more than core power.
overview: A plank transition between forearms and hands that trains shoulder stability and core control.
